title: The sl(2) weight system at c = -3/32 extends to a graph 4-invariant: paper, Lean 4 formalization and verification code
description:
Proof of the conjecture of Fomichev, Karev, Pavutnitskiy and Usanov (arXiv:2607.24217, Section 4) that the specialization of the sl(2) weight system at c = -3/32 extends to a 4-invariant of graphs. The extension is xi(G) = (-32)^{-n} S_G(-2), where S_G(N) is the signed count of assignments of 2-element subsets of {1,...,N} to the n vertices of G, with sign (-1)^{|p(x) ∩ p(y)|} on each edge xy.

paper/ holds the LaTeX source in the Elsevier elsarticle template and the compiled PDF; dist/ holds the PDF, the arXiv tarball and MasterSl2WeightSystemAtMinus3Over32Zip.zip with every file of the repository. lean/ is a Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the theorem (16 files); SL2W.main_theorem depends only on the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. checks/ contains independent checks in Python and Julia (exact rational arithmetic) and in C and C++ (arithmetic modulo 2^61 - 1), including a comparison with the values tabulated by Fomichev et al., and run_all.sh runs the Lean build, the axiom check and all programs.
